job.done.subject: [AUTOMATIC] bg job {id} finished, {verdict}{noOutput}: {label}
job.done.head: Background job {id} ({label}) finished after {elapsed}, {verdict}.
job.done.empty: It ended with NO output (EOF, 0 bytes): nothing was printed, which is not an error by itself.
job.done.pipeOpen: Its output pipe is still open: a child it started outlives it{survivors}. The command itself has ended; the exit code is its own.
job.done.marker: The exit code is 0 but the output contains a failure marker: {marker}. Read the log before you trust the exit code.
job.done.pipe: The command line has a pipe and its shell has no pipefail: the exit code is the last command's, not the first one's.
job.vanished.subjectUnknown: [AUTOMATIC] bg job {id} ended without an exit code: {label}
job.vanished.headExit: Background job {id} ({label}) ended after {elapsed}, exit {exit} (read from its exit file; its runner did not report it to the daemon, e.g. a daemon restart).
job.vanished.headUnknown: Background job {id} ({label}) is gone after {elapsed}: its runner was stopped or died before it reported an exit code (runner lost, exit unknown). Check `agenthq bg logs {id}`.
job.eof.subject: [AUTOMATIC] bg job {id} closed its output and is still running: {label}
job.eof.head: Background job {id} ({label}) closed its output (EOF after {bytes} bytes) after {elapsed}, but its process is still running: it has NOT ended. You will be told when it exits.
job.match.subject: [AUTOMATIC] bg job {id} matched '{match}' (still running)
job.match.head: Background job {id} ({label}) printed a line you asked to be told about and is still running after {elapsed}.
job.quiet.subject: [AUTOMATIC] bg job {id} quiet for {quiet}: {label}
job.quiet.head: Background job {id} ({label}) has printed nothing for {quiet} and is {state} after {elapsed}. If you are waiting on it, end your turn (you will be told when it ends) or check its log; if it finished, continue.
job.quiet.gone: no longer running (its end report has not arrived yet)
job.quiet.redirectHint: Output sent to a file is not visible to the watcher; to follow it use: agenthq watch-file {path}
job.heartbeat.subject: [AUTOMATIC] bg job {id} still running after {elapsed}: {label}
job.heartbeat.head: Background job {id} ({label}) is still running after {elapsed}; {logState}; {proc}. If you are waiting on it, end your turn again (next status in {next}); if it looks hung, check its log or stop it with `agenthq bg stop {id}`.
job.logPaused.subject: [AUTOMATIC] bg job {id}: log file paused, low disk space: {label}
job.logPaused.head: Background job {id} ({label}) is still running, but its log file is no longer written: {reason}. Its output still streams to the console that started it; quiet notices are off for it until it ends.
escalate.longWait.subject: [AUTOMATIC] session {session} has waited {elapsed} on bg job {id} with no end
escalate.longWait.body: Session {sessionFull} has waited {elapsed} on `{label}` ({logState}; {proc}). Status notices go on every {cap}.
escalate.optOut.subject: [AUTOMATIC] watch OFF: {session} runs `{label}` unwatched
escalate.optOut.body: Session {sessionFull} opted out of the output watch for `{label}`: {reason}
tree.ended.subject: [AUTOMATIC] a background process of this session ended: {command}
stall.idle.subject: [AUTOMATIC] stall check: idle {silent} with ticket {ticket} In Progress
stall.idle.body: Ticket {ticket} is In Progress, this session has been at rest for {silent} and no job of it is running. Continue the work; if something blocks it, record what blocks it the way your instructions say; if it is done, move the ticket and finish. (Waiting on a reply on purpose? Then ignore this notice.)
stall.idle.line: session {session} ({role}) idle {silent} on ticket {ticket} with no job running; nudged.
stall.busy.subject: [AUTOMATIC] stall check: a job ended {ago} ago and this session has been silent since
stall.busy.body: A job this session started ended {ago} ago (see the job notice in this mailbox), and the turn has shown no tool call or output since. Do not wait on it any longer: read its result and continue.
stall.busy.line: session {session} ({role}) is BUSY but silent {silent}; its job ended {ago} ago. Nudge queued until its turn ends; interrupt it if it stays stuck.
stall.foreground.subject: [AUTOMATIC] stall check: busy {silent} with no tool progress
stall.foreground.body: The turn has shown no tool call or output for {silent} and no watched job of this session is running: a foreground command may be hung or far too long. Stop it, rerun long work as `agenthq run-watched -- <cmd>`, narrow searches to the project, and continue.
stall.foreground.line: session {session} ({role}) is BUSY with no tool progress for {silent} on ticket {ticket} and no watched job (long or hung foreground call?). Nudge queued until its turn ends; interrupt it if it stays stuck.
runner.logPaused: [agenthq:note log file paused: {reason}; output continues on this console only]
runner.logTruncated: [agenthq:truncated {bytes} bytes from the head of this log (cap {cap})]
runner.marker: exit=0 but output contains failure marker: {marker}
runner.pipe: pipe without pipefail: the exit code is the last command's
